name: Takamine Ren'ya
source:
[spoiler]He supports Yoichi unconditionally despite knowing about his identity as a serial killer.

He is a chuunibyou and is implied to have been quite lonely before forming Rig Veda with Yoichi and Ghost. 

He likes flat chests.[/spoiler]
